<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
<title>Walker — Video Editor & Motion Designer</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,600;0,700;1,400&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
img{max-width:100%;display:block;}

:root{
  --bg:       #080808;
  --bg2:      #0c0c0c;
  --bg3:      #111;
  --gold:     #c9a55a;
  --gold-lt:  #dfc07a;
  --gold-dim: rgba(201,165,90,0.07);
  --gold-bdr: rgba(201,165,90,0.2);
  --text:     #ede8df;
  --muted:    #6b6660;
  --muted2:   #333;
}

body{font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);overflow-x:hidden;line-height:1.6;}

::-webkit-scrollbar{width:3px;}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--bg);}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--gold-bdr);border-radius:2px;}

/* NAV */
#nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;transition:background 0.4s,box-shadow 0.4s;}
#nav.scrolled{background:rgba(8,8,8,0.97);box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--gold-bdr);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);}
.nav-inner{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px;height:66px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;}
.nav-logo{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.7rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none;letter-spacing:3px;}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:34px;}
.nav-links a{font-size:0.76rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;transition:color 0.2s;}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--text);}
.nav-cta{font-size:0.74rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);border:1px solid var(--gold-bdr);padding:9px 22px;border-radius:2px;text-decoration:none;transition:background 0.22s,color 0.22s;}
.nav-cta:hover{background:var(--gold);color:#080808;}
.hamburger{display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:4px;}
.hamburger span{display:block;width:22px;height:1.5px;background:var(--text);transition:transform 0.3s,opacity 0.3s;}
.hamburger.open span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(6.5px) rotate(45deg);}
.hamburger.open span:nth-child(2){opacity:0;}
.hamburger.open span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-6.5px) rotate(-45deg);}
.mobile-menu{display:none;flex-direction:column;background:rgba(8,8,8,0.99);border-top:1px solid var(--gold-bdr);padding:6px 0 16px;}
.mobile-menu.open{display:flex;}
.mobile-menu a{padding:13px 28px;font-size:0.78rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;transition:color 0.2s;}
.mobile-menu a:hover{color:var(--gold);}
.mobile-menu .nav-cta{margin:10px 24px 0;text-align:center;display:block;}

/* HERO */
#hero{min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:110px 24px 70px;position:relative;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 50% at 50% 60%,rgba(201,165,90,0.05) 0%,transparent 65%),var(--bg);}
.hero-pre{font-size:0.7rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:22px;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp 0.8s ease 0.2s forwards;}
.hero-name{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(5rem,20vw,12rem);font-weight:700;line-height:0.88;color:var(--text);letter-spacing:-3px;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp 0.9s ease 0.4s forwards;}
.hero-line{width:0;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);margin:30px auto;animation:expandLine 1s ease 0.85s forwards;}
@keyframes expandLine{to{width:min(300px,65vw);}}
.hero-sub{font-size:clamp(0.68rem,2.2vw,0.8rem);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);max-width:500px;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp 0.8s ease 0.95s forwards;}
.hero-btns{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-top:46px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp 0.8s ease 1.15s forwards;}
.btn-gold{background:var(--gold);color:#080808;font-size:0.76rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:14px 32px;border-radius:2px;text-decoration:none;transition:background 0.22s,transform 0.18s;}
.btn-gold:hover{background:var(--gold-lt);transform:translateY(-2px);}
.btn-outline{background:transparent;color:var(--text);font-size:0.76rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:14px 32px;border-radius:2px;border:1px solid var(--muted2);text-decoration:none;transition:border-color 0.22s,color 0.22s,transform 0.18s;}
.btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--gold-bdr);color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-2px);}
.scroll-hint{position:absolute;bottom:36px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp 0.8s ease 1.5s forwards;}
.scroll-hint span{display:block;width:1px;height:38px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--gold-bdr),transparent);animation:pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;}
.scroll-hint p{font-size:0.62rem;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:0.7;}50%{opacity:0.2;}}

/* SECTIONS */
.section{padding:96px 24px;}
.section-dark{background:var(--bg2);}
.container{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;width:100%;}
.section-head{text-align:center;margin-bottom:60px;}
.section-label{display:inline-block;font-size:0.66rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:14px;}
.section-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(2.2rem,6vw,3.6rem);font-weight:700;line-height:1.08;color:var(--text);letter-spacing:-0.5px;}
.section-sub{font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:14px;font-weight:300;max-width:460px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;line-height:1.75;}

/* REVEAL */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity 0.72s ease,transform 0.72s ease;}
.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}
.d1{transition-delay:0.08s;}.d2{transition-delay:0.16s;}.d3{transition-delay:0.24s;}.d4{transition-delay:0.32s;}.d5{transition-delay:0.4s;}

/* ABOUT */
.about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.5fr;gap:80px;align-items:center;}
.photo-frame{width:100%;max-width:300px;margin:0 auto;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--gold-bdr);box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(201,165,90,0.03),0 0 70px rgba(201,165,90,0.07);aspect-ratio:1;}
.photo-frame img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
.about-text .section-label{margin-bottom:10px;}
.about-text .section-title{text-align:left;margin-bottom:20px;}
.about-desc{font-size:0.93rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:300;line-height:1.9;margin-bottom:32px;}
.tool-label{font-size:0.65rem;letter-spacing:3.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);display:block;margin-bottom:12px;}
.tool-list{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px;}
.tool{font-size:0.78rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--gold);border:1px solid var(--gold-bdr);padding:6px 15px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--gold-dim);letter-spacing:0.5px;}

/* SERVICES */
.services-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;}
.svc-card{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);border-radius:6px;padding:32px 26px;transition:border-color 0.25s,transform 0.25s,box-shadow 0.25s;cursor:default;}
.svc-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold-bdr);transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 16px 44px rgba(201,165,90,0.07);}
.svc-icon{width:40px;height:40px;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:20px;}
.svc-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.22rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:10px;}
.svc-desc{font-size:0.82rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:300;line-height:1.8;}

/* PORTFOLIO */
.portfolio-grid{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:22px;}
.vid-card{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;transition:border-color 0.25s,box-shadow 0.25s;}
.vid-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold-bdr);box-shadow:0 8px 44px rgba(201,165,90,0.07);}
.vid-card iframe{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;border:none;display:block;}
.yt-smart{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;cursor:pointer;background:#000;overflow:hidden;}
.yt-smart img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 0.3s,opacity 0.25s;}
.yt-smart:hover img{transform:scale(1.03);opacity:0.8;}
.yt-play-btn{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 0.2s;}
.yt-smart:hover .yt-play-btn{transform:scale(1.1);}
.yt-smart iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:none;}
.vid-info{padding:16px 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);}
.vid-title{font-size:0.86rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);}
.vid-tag{font-size:0.66rem;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border:1px solid var(--gold-bdr);padding:4px 10px;border-radius:2px;}
.vid-placeholder{aspect-ratio:16/9;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.015);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;}
.vid-placeholder svg{opacity:0.12;color:var(--gold);}
.vid-placeholder span{font-size:0.68rem;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted2);}

/* CONTACT */
.contact-intro{font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:300;max-width:380px;margin:14px auto 0;line-height:1.8;}
.contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:48px;max-width:680px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}
.contact-row2{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:14px;max-width:680px;margin:14px auto 0;}
.contact-row2 .contact-btn{width:calc(33.33% - 7px);}
.contact-btn{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:28px 16px;background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);border-radius:6px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--text);font-size:0.82rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0.3px;transition:border-color 0.22s,transform 0.2s,box-shadow 0.22s,color 0.22s;}
.contact-btn:hover{border-color:var(--gold-bdr);transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 10px 32px rgba(201,165,90,0.08);color:var(--gold);}
.contact-btn svg{width:30px;height:30px;flex-shrink:0;}
.contact-btn span{font-size:0.7rem;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:0.5px;}

/* FOOTER */
footer{padding:28px 24px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);text-align:center;}
footer p{font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--muted2);letter-spacing:0.8px;}
footer span{color:var(--gold);}

/* ANIMATIONS */
@keyframes fadeUp{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);}100%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}}

/* RESPONSIVE */
@media(max-width:768px){
  .nav-links,.nav-cta{display:none;}
  .hamburger{display:flex;}
  .section{padding:72px 20px;}
  .about-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px;text-align:center;}
  .photo-frame{max-width:200px;}
  .about-text .section-title{text-align:center;}
  .tool-list{justify-content:center;}
  .services-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;}
  .contact-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;}
  .contact-row2{gap:10px;}
  .contact-btn{padding:20px 10px;gap:8px;}
  .contact-btn svg{width:26px;height:26px;}
}
@media(max-width:480px){
  .services-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .hero-name{letter-spacing:-2px;}
}
</style>
</head>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {

  /* NAV scroll */
  var nav = document.getElementById('nav');
  window.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
    nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 40);
  });

  /* Hamburger */
  var btn  = document.getElementById('hamburger');
  var menu = document.getElementById('mobile-menu');
  btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    btn.classList.toggle('open');
    menu.classList.toggle('open');
  });
  menu.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function(a) {
    a.addEventListener('click', function() {
      btn.classList.remove('open');
      menu.classList.remove('open');
    });
  });

  /* Scroll reveal */
  var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
    entries.forEach(function(e) {
      if (e.isIntersecting) {
        e.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(e.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(function(el) {
    observer.observe(el);
  });

  /* Smooth scroll */
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(function(a) {
    a.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      var target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
      if (target) {
        e.preventDefault();
        window.scrollTo({ top: target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 66, behavior: 'smooth' });
      }
    });
  });

  /* YouTube + Google Drive smart player */
  document.querySelectorAll('.yt-smart').forEach(function(player) {
    player.addEventListener('click', function() {
      var iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
      iframe.allow = 'accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture';
      iframe.allowFullscreen = true;

      var driveId = player.getAttribute('data-drive');
      var ytId    = player.getAttribute('data-id');

      if (driveId) {
        iframe.src = 'https://drive.google.com/file/d/' + driveId + '/preview';
        iframe.allow = 'autoplay';
      } else if (ytId) {
        iframe.src = 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/' + ytId + '?autoplay=1&rel=0&vq=hd1080';
      }

      player.innerHTML = '';
      player.appendChild(iframe);
    });
  });

});
</script>
